summary: Dependency resolved from unpinned GitHub repository
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node` rather than a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm clones whatever the current HEAD of that GitHub repository points to and runs any lifecycle scripts it contains, without a commit SHA or integrity hash to pin the resolved code. The GitHub account and repository are not affiliated with the Baileys publisher scope, so control of the repository — through account takeover, ownership transfer, or a force-pushed branch — translates directly into code execution on any machine that installs this package. The dependency source is off-registry and mutable, so the installed bytes cannot be reproduced or audited against a pinned reference.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
